title: Kreativ Report Broken Link in Active Maintenance
description: A short update on what Kreativ Report Broken Link is built for and how it fits recurring WordPress maintenance work.
metaDescription: A short update on Kreativ Report Broken Link, its use case, and how it fits recurring WordPress maintenance work.
intro: Kreativ Report Broken Link is live and positioned as a practical cleanup tool for sites that need repeatable broken-link reporting.

items.title: Built for recurring maintenance
items.body: The plugin is aimed at WordPress teams that need a repeatable way to detect broken internal and external links without turning each audit into a manual crawl.

items.title: Best fit
items.body: It is most useful on sites where link quality directly affects trust, navigation, and editorial maintenance velocity.

items.title: What to expect
items.body: The value is not just in finding broken links once. The real use case is making link cleanup part of a predictable maintenance workflow.
